jobs.title: Senior Product Designer
jobs.description:
At Deliverect, our API-first platform is revolutionizing commerce by providing a connected suite of on and off-premise solutions. We empower both the food and retail industries to expand their revenue and simplify their operations, creating seamless experiences for businesses to sell anywhere and deliver everywhere. Join us in this exciting journey, where your contributions will directly impact how businesses connect with their customers in a rapidly evolving global market.


Department Focus:
The Product Department at Deliverect is at the forefront of the digital ordering revolution, dedicated to consistently delivering groundbreaking solutions to the global marketplace. Our team of passionate and innovative engineers, designers, and product managers architect tools that empower businesses to thrive in the evolving digital landscape, streamlining digital ordering for delivery and on-premise services. We are committed to creating user-friendly, dependable, and scalable technology that simplifies operations and enhances customer experiences, playing an integral role in the success of businesses worldwide. In our department, innovation is not just a concept; it's the driving force behind everything we do.
Your Impact:
As a Senior Product Designer for Kiosk, you will end-to-end own and elevate the guest-facing ordering experience across thousands of global restaurant locations. By combining exceptional interaction craft with strong product sense, you will define the product roadmap, design intuitive interfaces, and directly drive key guest funnel outcomes like completion rates, average ticket size, and ordering speed.
This is a contract, hybrid role with a flexible work schedule, offering 3 days in our Paris office and 2 days from the comfort of your home.

jobs.description:
THE WORLD’S MOST ADVANCED VPN, AND A WHOLE LOT MORE.

If you're a curious problem-solver who carves their own path, join the team building NordVPN's next chapter: Connect, Protect, Monitor. From the fastest VPN on the planet to the tools that catch threats before they land, we're putting privacy, security, and control back in people's hands.
Your impact? Helping millions take back control of their online security, privacy, and data.




MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Product Ownership: Lead NordVPN Browser Extension app development from discovery to launch and iteration.

 - Vision & Roadmap: Set the Browser Extension product vision and roadmap. Turn strategy into deliverables.

 - Backlog Management: Own and prioritize the backlog. Write clear requirements from data, feedback, and stakeholders.

 - Collaboration: Align engineering, design, research, marketing, and product around one plan. Drive execution.

 - User & Market Insight: Track Browser Extension user feedback and product data. Monitor trends and competitors. Act on insights.

 - Technical Execution: Partner with engineering on feasibility, dependencies, and trade-offs. Remove blockers. Deliver on time.

 - Quality Focus: Drive a user-first, data-driven approach. Improve UX and stability release over release.

 - Define KPIs for the Browser Extension app. Monitor results and adjust priorities.




CORE REQUIREMENTS

 - Experience: 3+ years in product management or product ownership.

 - Analytics: Strong at turning technical context, user data, and research into product decisions.

 - Communication: Clear communication with stakeholders and delivery teams.

 - Problem Solving: Structured, analytical thinking. Finding root causes and proposing practical solutions.

 - Ownership: Strong ownership and prioritization. Ability to manage multiple workstreams in a fast-paced team.

 - Tools: Comfortable with Jira and Confluence, Analytical Tools, Figma.

 - User Focus: Strong user empathy and focus on secure, reliable, high-performing desktop products.




 


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Sharpen your edge: training, mentorship, and room to grow — always.
   
   

 - Take the time you need: extra vacation days, sick days, and time off when life calls.
   
   

 - Get premium healthcare: private health insurance in Lithuania and Poland — fully covered.
   
   

 - Protect your peace: enjoy free subscriptions to Calm, Headspace, and Mindletic, and our own resilience and mindfulness trainings.
   
   

 - Own your fitness: in-house gyms, sport cards, online workouts, and personal guidance — on us.
   
   

 - Pack your bags for workation: experience our company-wide trip abroad to the fullest.
   
   

 - Work from anywhere: work from wherever keeps you in the zone.
   
   

 - Celebrate your milestones: birthdays, weddings, and new family members — all deserve a gift.
   
   

 - Parent with ease: children’s summer camps and flexibility around the schedule — because parenting never pauses.
   
   

 - Join the party: team building and company events people talk about for months.
   
   

 - Unlock Cyber City: coffee bar, open gyms, kids’ room, music room, massage chairs — our Vilnius HQ is yours to enjoy.
